versions.changelog: 技能页文案升级：痛点钩子前置 + 保留触发词

Major update: dawn-office-suite v2.0.0 integrates five document processing skills into one suite.

- Now supports unified handling of Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files.
- Enables creation, reading, editing, and advanced manipulation for .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, and PDF.
- Adds comprehensive "Office综合" route for tips across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace.
- Merges features previously available in separate skills for streamlined office document workflows.
